messages:
Maya (Design): dropped a new prototype for the model catalog compare + filter UX. quick context: trying a compact URL token for filter state, explicit account pinning for versions, and updated micro-badge treatments. link: https://figma.com/file/abc (frame: compact-url + pin-flow). thoughts?
Ravi (PM): main goals: 1) shareable links for support and docs, 2) predictable return-to where filters don't vanish, 3) pinning that survives sign-in. tradeoffs?
Claire (A11y): accessibility first: any filter chips must be actionable buttons with aria-pressed and a readable aria-label. permalinks are fine but ensure screen reader announces when filters are restored.
Omar (Frontend): implementation idea: pack the filter object into a compact base64 token, store in query param like ?f=eyJ... . pros: shortish links. cons: opaque for debugging and might exceed URL length if user applies a lot.
Nina (FE): alternative: always store canonical state server-side via a share token id (short id in URL). user clicks "Share filters" -> server saves and returns /catalog?share=abcd. avoids long URLs but needs backend.
Maya (Design): UX suggestion: show a tiny indicator in the filter bar when the page is using a restored session state: "Restored filters (Restore filters)" with an inline action. keep the primary CTA for clearing filters as "Clear filters" (explicit).
Ravi (PM): prefer explicit server-side share token for official permalinks. allow client-side compact URLs for quick copy. sync rules: URL param overrides local session. document this behaviour in API docs.
Claire (A11y): toast semantics: role="status" and live region updates. the restore action should be a real button with clear label; avoid ambiguous "Undo" — good that copy is "Restore filters". also ensure focus management: after restore, focus goes to first active filter chip.
Omar (Frontend): note on focus: when opening compare modal it should trap focus but initial keyboard focus should be on the compare table header (first column sort), then tabbing into rows. avoids forcing keyboard users to hunt for the X.
Nina (FE): pin behavior: two modes: account-pinned (persist in user preferences) vs session-pinned. implementation plan: save account pins on the profile endpoint; for guests fallback to session pinned in localStorage. need backend owner for profile pins.
Maya (Design): pin icon microcopy: tooltip "Pin this model version for comparisons". when pinned, show tiny label "Pinned" + date. for multiple pins, we need a lightweight pinned-list drawer accessible from header.
Ravi (PM): add to roadmap: pinned-list drawer and API for managing pins. backlog item to discuss retention (auto-expire?).
Claire (A11y): badges: small colored performance badges failed contrast in the mock. suggestion: use an outline + icon approach so color is supplementary. ensure text has 4.5:1 or we include readable icon+text alternative.
Omar (Frontend): agree on outline + svg icon. provide exact token names and alternate states (hover/focus/active). I'll prototype small SVG sprites for the lightning icon.
Nina (FE): will also add aria-hidden on decorative svgs and include an aria-label on the badge container like "Performance: latency 42ms" for ATs.
Maya (Design): copy tweak: change the compare CTA to "Compare selected models (x)" instead of just "Compare" so the affordance communicates count. small change but helpful.
Ravi (PM): action items: Maya to update figma with toast + badge outline and pinned drawer sketch; Claire to write accessibility checklist (chips, toast, compare modal focus, badges); Omar & Nina to prototype compact URL vs server token and pin API stub. I'll follow up in 24h with a short sync.
design-bot: Heads up: follow-up design review scheduled in 24h. :bell: 
Maya (Design): tiny follow-up: made the toast copy "Filters restored — Restore filters" and added an explicit "Clear filters" button in the bar. ping me if anything blocks. :sparkles:
Claire (A11y): leaving a couple comments in figma re: focus rings and hit targets. will approve once checklist is done.
Omar (Frontend): starting POC now for base64 token encoding, will post link with sample decoded payload.
Nina (FE): pairing with Omar on sync logic later today. marking thread resolved until POC is up. :white_check_mark:
